name: wcag-toolkit
description: WCAG 2.2 tools for Claude Code: audit a finished site into a client-ready PDF report, and build new UI that meets WCAG from the first version.

plugins.name: wcag-toolkit
plugins.description: Both tools in one plugin: /wcag-toolkit:wcag-report audits a site or repository into a client-ready PDF report, /wcag-toolkit:wcag-build builds WCAG 2.2 requirements into UI work before it is planned. Install this or the individual plugins, not both.

plugins.name: wcag-report
plugins.description: Crawl a website or run a repository locally, check every page against WCAG 2.2 and produce a client-ready PDF accessibility report that passes an independent red-team review.

plugins.name: wcag-build
plugins.description: Build UI that meets WCAG 2.2 from the first version: before Claude plans a component, block or restyle, it works out which criteria the change could break and builds the requirements in.
